title: Balanced truncation for bilinear time-delay systems with approximate Gramians
summary: A balanced truncation (BT) procedure is presented to achieve a structure-preserving model order reduction (MOR) for bilinear time-delay systems in this paper. We attempt to define Gramians for bilinear time-delay systems based on Volterra series theory. The controllability and observability Gramians in the frequency domain are given explicitly, which align with the ones of bilinear systems and time-delay systems.
